lines.text: They had never won the league. Then they won it seven times in a row.
Lyon had never been champions of France. On 4 May 2002 they beat leaders Lens three one to win the title.
Lyon won seven French titles in a row under four coaches, still the longest run in French football.
Lyon signed Michael Essien from Bastia in 2003. Two years later Chelsea made him their record signing.
Juninho Pernambucano arrived at Lyon on a free transfer and scored 100 goals, 44 direct from free kicks.
Weeks after Alain Perrin won Lyon's seventh title and first double, the club let him go.
Is a club that sells its best player every summer and still wins stronger or weaker for it?
